data.name: Swamp Game
data.detailed_description:
Swamp Game is the definitive swamp life simulation experience. Set in an alternate dimension where the swamp has claimed all, you play the part of the Swamp's newest inhabitant. Waking up with a hole in your head and nothing but the clothes on your body, do you have what it takes to get by, make a living and conquer the Swamp life?

  • Many ways to make money: Complete odd jobs and side gigs, develop your career and rise the ranks, set up active and passive businesses to keep the capital flowing.

  • Many reasons to need money: Swamp life is hard. Fulfill your needs, abuse your vices to get by and whatever you do pay your rent, swamp life gets a lot harder without a roof over your head.

  • Improve your character: Increase attirbutes like Pizzazz to better impress those you meet and perhaps climb the corporate ladder a little faster. Learn a variety of skills like fishing or electronics to provide alternate ways to get by.

  • Swampland Stock Exchange: A soil based stock market. Play it safe with bluechip options like clay. Bet your life savings day trading divested mud options. Sandy Loam, who is she?

  • Many peculiar inhabitants: The swamp is full of life both friend and foe, how will you navigate this complex landscape. Are you a lover or a fighter?

  • Own and customise property: Be it renting or buying out right (lucky you), own and customise your own property with furniture and items you've collected from your time living in the swamp.

Minimum:

  • Processor: Intel Core i7-7700HQ 3.6GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6GB
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD Install Recommended

content_descriptors.notes: Low-polygon and retro stylized depiction of violence, dismemberment, legal and illegal drug use, and profanity.
